description_en: Retrieves all managed clusters for the current user
description_zh: 获取当前用户所有已纳管的集群
name: ListClusters

parameters.help_en: The current page number (starting from page 1)
parameters.name: current

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_zh: 通过插件的名字过滤插件
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
Filters by cluster ID.

This cluster ID is not the ACK cluster ID. It is the `id` field returned by this operation
parameters.help_zh:
通过集群 ID 过滤

这个集群ID不是 ACK 集群ID，而是通过本接口返回的数据里面的 `id` 字段
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
`Running`: The cluster is managed normally.
`Installing`: An installation task is in progress for the cluster.
`Uninstalling`: An uninstallation task is in progress for the cluster.
`Upgrading`: An update task is in progress for the cluster.
`Offline`: The cluster is offline and management is abnormal
parameters.help_zh:
`Running` : 集群纳管正常；
`Installing`: 集群有安装任务正在进行；
`Uninstalling`: 集群有卸载任务正在进行；
`Upgrading`: 集群有更新任务正在进行；
`Offline`: 集群离线，纳管异常
parameters.name: cluster_status

parameters.help_en:
`ACK`: ACK cluster.
`CUSTOM`: Custom cluster (default clusters belong to custom clusters)
parameters.help_zh:
`ACK`: ACK 集群
`CUSTOM`: 自定义集群（默认集群属于自定义集群）
parameters.name: cluster_type

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] Use the cluster_id parameter to filter instead
parameters.help_zh: 本字段已废弃，请使用 cluster_id 字段过滤
parameters.name: id
